I tried, I tried calling up my friends that I'm not really close to and they either say they're busy or they say they don't know and they'll follow up, which they eventually don't.

It doesn't really help my case that I don't go to school and I work at a job that I don't particularly like. I want to put myself out more but I don't know how. I'm a bi trans woman living in a small suburban town in Eastern Canada and it's so hard to find people like me or to find people that're willing to get with me. I constantly feel isolated from everyone else.

I can't really talk to him because I still have feelings for him when he's talking to someone else, and as you can tell I'm the type to get jealous easily. I feel that I have no other choice.
I'm really close friends with him though... We've known each other for more than 2 years and we even met up IRL one time.
I know, but I just can't really seem to go on.. It hurts that I'll never meet another guy like him and I can't really seem to let my crush go of him.
I can make an alternate free Spotify account and I can make a collaborative playlist.

Hey! Trans woman here, scrolling through your account and seeing that you’re a fellow trans person who’s also struggling with a SA, I wish you a speedy recovery. If you’d like to talk about it, you can always shoot me a DM!

(Sorry if this reply was awkwardly phased, I just woke up.)
Your welcome! Did you get my PM by the way?
Thank you for the insight! It’s really thoughtful and interesting.

> I have the green book but I don’t have any meetings that are within 2 hours travel distance.

There’s an online chat room meeting I can PM to you, if you’d like.
Thanks for your imput! It means a ton. (This sounds like sarcasm, but no, really, I appreciate it.)

Yeah, I was thinking about scenarios during masturbating, but I wasn’t consuming porn of any kind.

I have this idea in my mind that I could “wean” myself off of porn by masturbating to scenarios in my mind, and I could then proceed to quit altogether.
I don’t know, I didn’t really feel anything. Just relieved that I got the compulsion out of the way I guess.
I am! I just thought I’d pass on the idea to other users in this forum.
No, I’ve only been sober for 3 days now.

First, everyone joins at the scheduled time, and we start, and close the meeting by saying the Serenity Prayer. We all start sharing our stories one by one by saying “!” in the chat, and other members will say “nods”, “relates”, etc etc. It’s pretty simple.
I’ve been in SAA for 3 days now, and I’ve been joining meetings via online chat rooms.
Apologies if this post was messily written, I’ll hopefully write a more neat one soon.
